primary_benefit: Provides an uncorrupted benchmark for deep learning feature extraction. Guarantees that classification models do not learn preprocessing-induced artifacts.
primary_risk: Dense glandular regions (BI-RADS density C/D) exhibit lower local contrast, potentially challenging early-stage feature extraction in shallow networks.
evidence_gaps: Effect on deep CNN convolutional feature activations must be quantified empirically in Stage 14.

primary_benefit: Highest entropy (4.93 bits) among contrast methods; boosts subtle border visibility in dense tissue, which may facilitate mass margin discrimination in CNNs.
primary_risk: May subtly elevate high-frequency sensor noise in low-density adipose regions; tile boundaries could theoretically produce microscopic gradient discontinuities.
evidence_gaps: Tested on 16 pilot mammograms; generalizability across the full 3,568 corpus and impact on classification false-positive rates must be tested in Stages 13–17.

primary_benefit: Accentuates high-frequency spatial transitions critical for microcalcification cluster and subtle spiculated malignant lesion detection.
primary_risk: Indiscriminate high-frequency gain sharpens background quantum mottle and scanner noise, which may lead CNN feature extractors to attend to spurious noise spikes.
evidence_gaps: Whether edge sharpening increases true positive sensitivity or simply elevates false positives on normal fibroglandular parenchyma remains unknown prior to Stage 14.

experimental_source: Stage 7 Factorial Sharpening Experiment (Condition: clahe + unsharp_mask)
primary_benefit: Maximizes visual conspicuity by simultaneously expanding local dynamic range and sharpening fine edges.
primary_risk: Compounding risk: CLAHE local noise enhancement is subsequently sharpened by unsharp masking. Highest mean absolute change from baseline (1.32 intensity levels; max diff 111.0).
evidence_gaps: Must be validated downstream to ensure CNN models are not distracted by intensified texture patterns.

primary_benefit: Demonstrated top general restoration (36.06 dB PSNR, 0.8037 SSIM) in Stage 10 benchmark; serves as a controlled candidate to evaluate whether noise suppression helps CNN generalization.
primary_risk: Critical Clinical Risk: Denoising raw, uncorrupted clinical scans risks blurring subtle, punctate microcalcifications (< 0.2 mm) and fine spicules, potentially destroying life-saving diagnostic cues. Stage 10 evaluations evaluated synthetic noise, not native scanner noise.
evidence_gaps: Denoising was benchmarked against artificial synthetic noise. Its utility on clinical scans without added noise is unproven and must be compared directly against Baseline (C1) in Stage 14.

experimental_source: Stage 6 Contrast Experiment & Stage 11 Visual Panels
primary_risk: Severely expands global dynamic range across non-breast background areas, amplifying sensor noise. Causes excessive saturation and whiteout in dense fibroglandular parenchyma, obliterating fine internal mass structures. Entropy decreased from 4.6143 to 4.5282 bits.
evidence_gaps: Excluded based on empirical evidence from Stages 6–11.

experimental_source: Stage 10 Quantitative Summary & Stage 11 Magnified Crops
primary_risk: Indiscriminate low-pass spatial filtering washes out fine structural details and smooths out microcalcifications. Mean gradient dropped to 0.0642 (lowest of all methods). Inferior SSIM (0.7521) to median filtering.
evidence_gaps: Excluded based on empirical evidence from Stages 6–11.

experimental_source: Stage 10 Quantitative Summary & Stage 9 Runtime Logs
primary_risk: Extreme computational complexity (~10-15 seconds per high-resolution mammogram, requiring > 10 hours for 3,568 images). Low restoration fidelity under Comparison B (PSNR 27.88 dB, SSIM 0.6349), indicating aggressive alteration of native tissue.
evidence_gaps: Excluded based on empirical evidence from Stages 6–11.

experimental_source: Stage 10 Summary by Method & Noise Type
primary_risk: Highly specialized for salt-and-pepper noise (PSNR 52.77 dB), but inferior to standard median filtering on continuous Gaussian, Poisson, and Speckle noise models (overall PSNR 33.82 dB vs 36.06 dB for standard median).
evidence_gaps: Excluded based on empirical evidence from Stages 6–11.

strategy_name: Arbitrary Multi-Stage Pipelines (e.g. Denoise -> HistEq -> Sharpen)
primary_risk: Scientific boundary: Chaining operations that were never tested in Stages 5–11 violates reproducible research protocols. Only factorial combinations explicitly tested in Stage 7 (CLAHE + Unsharp Mask) are eligible for shortlisting.
evidence_gaps: Excluded based on empirical evidence from Stages 6–11.
